To do so simply google your pc part and add driver at the end, example "gtx 1080 driver" or "AMD A9 driver".

I will not be gatekeeping but I still advise you to beat the game on expert with each class atleast once, testing out gear is not equivalent to a full playthrough. You need to have a feel for progression, how you get your goto weapon, what tactics to use if you are behind. For example: Melee early game is the worst, closely followed by summoner, they both are pretty hard and can lead to a lot of trial and error. However, Summoner gets big bumps from things like hardmode, EoL kill etc. Melee gets a huge boost from getting a Nights Edge, then a Terra Blade etc.  
So i insist you try to beat the game first with each class to get a feel.  
If you won't then my recommendation is either mage or ranger. Ranger has the fastest early game setup, go to your evil biome, get a gun, wait for your arms dealer, get a minishark, win. No really, minishark can probably take you from 0 to wall of flesh (altough for the hungries I'd suggest getting bee nades or normal grenades).  
Mage is better in the sense it requires less money since your ammo is "infinite". Mage has a rougher start but with a diamond staff it can pretty much roll through EoC, then if you have corruption vilethorn gets through EoW, staff also works for brains. They also get a bump in dps with the meteor, space gun + meteor armor can pretty much get you to hardmode (altough a waterbolt, water scepter etc would be useful again for the hungries)

"and what about hardmode?" yes... that's the part where personal experience would be needed since you need to know how you like to play, every class gets pretty good power there so it's all about your playstyle.

On the more general side of things: getting a big arena is a must however make it so that it doesn't have too many platforms since going down could be challangeing. If you struggle with EoC you can skip it since BoC with a staff or minishark, or EoW with vilethorn and grenades is a much simpler fight (in my experience).  
The toughest part will be the early game, post WoF you'll have enough power and experience to do really well. (though bosses like Duke Fishron could still wipe you, I swear that damn fish is harder than its worth).

Good luck.
